# CKW Elements

CKW Elements is CKW's design system for React applications. It ships design tokens and React components as npm packages.

## Primary Resources

- Full AI guide: llms-full.txt
- Token CSS: tokens/tokens.css
- Token JavaScript: tokens/tokens.js
- Token JSON: tokens/tokens.json
- React prototyping skill: skills/ckw-prototyping.md
- React component skill: skills/ckw-components.md

## Packages

- `@ckw-elements/tokens`: CSS custom properties, JavaScript token exports, and DTCG JSON.
- `@ckw-elements/components`: React components that use CKW semantic tokens.

## Core Rules

- Import `@ckw-elements/tokens/tokens.css` once in the application entry point.
- Use semantic tokens like `var(--interactive-primary)`, not primitive tokens like `var(--color-green-600)`, in product components.
- CKW brand color is green. Do not make primary UI blue.
- CKW brand font is Gotham via `var(--font-family-brand), sans-serif`.
- React TSX files in this repository must keep `import React from 'react';`.

## React Usage

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Button, InputField, SegmentedControl } from '@ckw-elements/components';
import '@ckw-elements/tokens/tokens.css';
```

```css
@import '@ckw-elements/tokens/tokens.css';
```
